title: 2022 building code energy and accessibility standards adopted (Queensland)
summary: Queensland applied the NCC 2022 residential energy efficiency (7-star) standards from 1 May 2024 through the Queensland Development Code; livable housing is reported to have applied from 1 October 2023 (not confirmed).

instruments.title: National Construction Code 2022 (residential energy efficiency and livable housing) as adopted in Queensland
instruments.provisions: state adoption of NCC 2022 Volume Two and the Livable Housing Design Standard (instrument not checked)

commenced.what: NCC 2022 residential energy efficiency (7 stars) applied through QDC 4.1

direction_rationale: The 2022 code raised minimum energy performance for new homes to 7 stars and added livable housing design requirements. Design and compliance costs are partly fixed per dwelling and may fall hardest on small builders, lowering entry and raising exit.
comparison: Staggered and partial adoption 2023-2025 (NSW and WA did not adopt the livable housing provisions)

verified.notes: Date from the Queensland Building and Construction Commission; the ABCB table gives no Queensland dates.
